== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Description:''' head-and-shoulders portrait of Sandy Wible.
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Sandy Wible]].
* '''Portion used:''' a crop of the low resolution LinkedIn publishes; no larger copy was taken.
* '''Replaceability:''' no free photograph of the subject is known.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use of the photograph.
* '''Copyright:''' the photographer or Sandy Wible. Used under fair use for identification only.
